name: Smart Content Preview
description: Lets an editor force specific Smart Content segments to evaluate as true so personalized variations can be previewed without matching the real conditions.
project_description:
The Smart Content Preview module works with the Smart Content module. When adding or editing a segment set, this module will add a Preview checkbox next to each segment. If checked, that segment will always result in a true condition, regardless of whether or not the conditions are met. This can be used for previewing segment results or for testing purposes.

 Features 
 
 Preview segment results that you have in Smart Content 
 Easy button for content editors to see what the content would look like 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Once installed, a "Preview" checkbox will appear in your Smart Content administration, which will allow previewing segmented content.

 Recommended modules/libraries
